description: ACCDB: seed T(ID PK, B BIGINT) with boundary values; create saved QueryDefs QBiSel (PARAMETERS p BigInt), QBiRange (PARAMETERS pLo BigInt, pHi BigInt), and QBiIns (PARAMETERS pid Long, pv BigInt). Keeps all pages after CreateQueryDef, after QBiIns.Execute, and after Close; inspects Parameter.Type/Name/Value, binds 0, 2147483647, '2147483648', '9223372036854775807', '-9223372036854775808', Null, out-of-range '9223372036854775808', and 'abc'.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, B BIGINT)
PARAMETERS p BigInt; SELECT ID, B, p AS pv, VarType(p) AS vt, TypeName(p) AS tn FROM T WHERE B = p ORDER BY ID;
PARAMETERS pLo BigInt, pHi BigInt; SELECT ID, B FROM T WHERE B BETWEEN pLo AND pHi ORDER BY ID;
PARAMETERS pid Long, pv BigInt; INSERT INTO T (ID, B) VALUES (pid, pv);
SELECT ID, B FROM T WHERE ID = 99
